notes.title: Get ADventureLib + 4 Games and 2 Albums for $3!
notes.content:
Groupees has launched the Miller on the Roof bundle, including ADventure Lib and it's soundtrack. It's all one tier, so $3 gets you five games (all redeemable on steam) and two albums. Noah T's album is royalty free - so it's great if you want to add music to a game or stream, and lets not forget the famous HP Lovecraft Historical Society's album "A Shoggoth on the Roof!"

You can check out the bundle here: [url=https://groupees.com/millerontheroof]Miller on the Roof[/url]

[h1]The Games:[/h1]
[list]
[*]ASTROKILL
[*]Rolling Sun
[*]Kumoon : Ballistic Physics Puzzle
[*]ADventure Lib (includes DRM-free version and soundtrack)
[/list]

[h1]The Albums:[/h1]
[*]Noah T's Royalty Free Pack
[*]HP Lovecraft Historical Society's A Shoggoth on the Roof
[/list]
